title: Lady On The Beach Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Lady on the Beach is a 2 BR / 2 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. The elegant Lady on the Beach cottage adds a true air of sophistication, as upscale finishes and modern décor blend to create a unique showpiece, within a casual, yet refined setting.
description_expanded: Description170 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA - SLEEPS SIXCharming One-Story Cottage Near the Beach in Seaside, FloridaLady on the Beach is a rare one-story cottage in the heart of Seaside, Florida, ideally positioned just steps from Seaside Avenue and Ruskin Park. With its premier location and short walk to the private residential beach, this thoughtfully designed home offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and relaxed coastal living.Inviting Outdoor Spaces Designed for RelaxationGuests are welcomed by a screened-in front porch with classic rocking chairs and outdoor dining for three, setting the tone for laid-back mornings and breezy evenings. Additional outdoor living areas allow the home to live much larger, offering multiple places to unwind after a day spent at the beach or exploring Seaside.Open-Concept Living & Gourmet KitchenInside, the cottage features an open floor plan that keeps everyone connected. The updated kitchen overlooks the living area and includes breakfast bar seating for five, making it ideal for casual meals and conversation.The kitchen is fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, including a Bosch dishwasher and Gourmet Viking dual-fuel stainless steel stove, along with gourmet knives, a Keurig, Nespresso machine, and complimentary coffee pods for added convenience.Comfortable Living & Dining AreasThe airy living space sits at the center of the home, offering two comfortable sofas, one of which converts into a queen sleeper, and a flatscreen TV with Sonos sound bar. This inviting area serves as the perfect gathering spot after a sun-filled day.Adjacent to the living room, a dining table for six opens directly onto the front screened porch, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor dining.Private Bedrooms & Renovated BathroomsJust off the living area, guests will find two well-appointed bedrooms. The front bedroom features a king bed, privacy doors, a flatscreen TV, and a renovated en-suite bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination.The rear bedroom offers a queen bed, ample closet space, a mounted flatscreen TV, and its own updated bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination.Backyard Retreat & Outdoor AmenitiesThe queen bedroom opens onto a rear screened porch with Adirondack seating for two, overlooking an outdoor deck and large fenced backyard complete with a gardener’s edible garden. Beyond the porch, guests can enjoy a wooded deck, gas grill, outdoor shower, and plenty of shaded space for gathering with family and friends.Your Seaside Escape AwaitsWith its unbeatable location, thoughtful layout, and inviting outdoor spaces, Lady on the Beach offers a truly special Seaside vacation experience. Whether you’re relaxing on the porch, walking to the beach, or enjoying time together indoors, this charming cottage is ready to welcome you.* 7-night minimum Fourth of July. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES1,022 square feet of thoughtfully designed, single-story livingAccess to Seaside’s private residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion352 yards (approximately a 5-minute walk) to beach accessGas grill for outdoor cooking and entertainingPeacock Alley premium linens featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeQueen sleeper sofa for additional sleeping accommodationsWasher & dryer located in a spacious laundry roomKeurig coffee maker with complimentary pods providedNespresso machine with pods includedAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking information: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered a vehicle and count as one parking space. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside, except in approved special circumstances or medical needs with a valid permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001966
